verdict.rationale: Pipedream ships an official MCP server (Connect MCP) that exposes thousands of app actions as callable tools for external agents, with built-in auth handling so agents can call tools on behalf of users — confirmed in docs and via llms.txt probe. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation that the MCP server works reliably in production, and explicit confirmation that custom user-built workflows (not just pre-built app actions) can be exposed as MCP tools.
